description: Find Medicare Benefits Schedule (MBS) items by item number or by words describing the procedure or service. Returns each match's descriptor, schedule fee and Medicare benefits from the current schedule. Use it first when you have a procedure but not an item number. Never put patient identifiers in the query.

limit.description: How many items to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.

query.description: An item number or its start (for example 3038), or a few words naming the procedure or service (for example gallbladder removal). Never include patient names, dates of birth or other identifying details.

name: search_mbs_items
title: Search MBS items
